data.exact_reserve_text: On 23 December 2019 Syndicate 1110 entered into a loss portfolio transfer (LPT) reinsurance with Syndicate 3334, managed by Hamilton Underwriting Limited (HUL), for certain lines of discontinued business for underwriting years 2016 to 2018 inclusive. The transaction resulted in an increase to Syndicate 1110's gross written premium of GBP 59.7m and an increase to gross and net technical provisions of GBP 60.1m.

prior_year_events.impact_description: increase to gross and net technical provisions of GBP 60.1m for discontinued business for underwriting years 2016 to 2018 inclusive

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1110 experienced a significant strengthening of prior year reserves in 2019, primarily driven by a Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) transaction. On 23 December 2019, the syndicate accepted an LPT from Syndicate 3334, which resulted in a GBP 60.1m increase to gross technical provisions for discontinued Directors & Officers, Financial Institutions, and Professional Indemnity business covering underwriting years 2016 to 2018. This represents a 64.27% strengthening relative to the opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 93.512m. Additionally, an accounting policy change was implemented to include loss funds within IBNR, which could also impact reserve movements. While the syndicate reported a net profit of GBP 0.2m attributable to the 2017 and prior years of account, the gross LPT impact is used as the primary prior year development figure.
raw_causal_phrases: remove loss funds from the paid claims and include the funds within IBNR
